description: This file defines the GenericPK class, which models a generic primary key for entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides factory methods for creating primary key instances in various ways, overrides hashCode and equals for proper identity management, and supports cloning of primary key objects.

classes.name: GenericPK
classes.description: A class representing a generic primary key for an entity, providing factory methods, equality, hashCode, and cloning functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericPK instance from a ModelEntity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericPK instance from a Delegator, ModelEntity, and a Map of fields.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericPK instance from a Delegator, ModelEntity, and a single primary key value.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericPK instance from an existing GenericPK.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this primary key, based on superclass implementation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, returning true if the object is a GenericPK and equal to this instance.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a shallow clone of this GenericPK instance.
